title: Moss and the Paw Prints
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ue' and 'aw'.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog digging at the edge of a neat green lawn.
Moss the hedgehog trotting away across the lawn.
Moss the hedgehog standing still, looking around worriedly for his den.
Moss the hedgehog peering down closely at the grass underfoot.
Moss the hedgehog noticing small paw prints pressed into a patch of mud.
Close view of the small paw prints, matching Moss the hedgehog's own paw.
Moss the hedgehog pressing his paw into the mud to make a matching mark.
Moss the hedgehog comparing his own paw print with the ones in the mud.
A line of small paw prints leading back across the lawn towards a den.
Moss the hedgehog arriving happily back at his den.
